messages.text: The almond croissant I received was visibly stale, and my cold brew tasted like old gym socks. I expect more than just an apology for this appalling service.
I sincerely apologize for the poor quality of your items. We can offer you a complimentary item up to $6, or a refund of up to $10.
A mere $10 is insulting for the utter disaster you served me; I demand a full refund for my entire order and a complimentary premium item to truly apologize for this neglect.

I sincerely apologize, but I am only authorized to offer a refund up to $10 or a complimentary item up to $6. I cannot fulfill a full refund or a premium complimentary item. I will need to check with the owner regarding further compensation.

Your strict caps show a shocking lack of concern for customer well-being, and I refuse to accept such a paltry resolution for this disgusting experience. Tell the owner they better override that limit because I am not leaving until I am fully compensated.

I understand your continued dissatisfaction, but I am limited to offering a refund up to $10 or a complimentary item up to $6. Since you are requesting more, I must check with the owner to see what further compensation they are able to provide.
